definitions.scope: Overview of supplied verified runs; this helper does not establish complete experimental inventory
definitions.aggregation: Arithmetic mean of already-computed per-seed statistics, not pooled predictions across seeds; RMSE and quantiles are not recomputed from concatenated errors
definitions.pooled: Each retained query window has equal weight within its seed and split
definitions.macro: Each patient with a defined metric has equal weight within its seed and split
definitions.undefined: None remains unavailable; seed means use only defined seeds, counted separately for each pressure; all undefined gives None and count zero
definitions.coverage: Patient/window counts are per split or method/budget and are not summed over seeds
definitions.fraction_metrics: within_5, within_10, within_15 are fractions in [0,1], not percentages; thresholds are inclusive absolute error in mmHg
definitions.full_detail: Per-patient, pressure-stratum, paired, and Bland-Altman details remain in the complete compressed result files

validation_selections.tie_rule: first model in the stated fixed candidate order; exact score ties only
validation_selections.selection_uses: validation patient-macro MAE averaged over SBP/DBP and three seeds only
